name: MLPRender_Fea
aliases: MLP Render with Feature and View Positional Encoding
definition: A neural rendering module that predicts RGB color from input features, view directions, and positions using a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) with positional encoding applied to features and view direction, but NOT position.
summary: MLPRender_Fea is a neural rendering module that predicts RGB color from features and view directions using positional encoding, decoupling appearance synthesis from density prediction.
